rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After a tenancy has lasted 30 days, an owner may not terminate it without just cause stated in a written notice. At-fault causes include non-payment of rent, material lease breach, nuisance and criminal activity. No-fault causes include owner move-in, removal from the rental market, and demolition or substantial remodel. For a curable violation, the owner must first give notice of the violation and time to fix it. For a no-fault termination, the owner must either pay 3 months of relocation assistance or waive rent for the final 3 months. Owners had to give existing tenants written notice of these protections before Dec. 19, 2021, or at lease commencement or renewal.
rules.key_value: Just cause required after 30 days; no-fault termination requires 3 months' relocation assistance or waiver of the final 3 months' rent; notice and opportunity to cure before an at-fault termination notice

new_construction_exemption.basis: housing produced in the last 15 years

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property in Santa Ana except housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories and other shared living quarters.
coverage.other_conditions: The exemption list in the source is truncated after 'dormito[ries]'.

rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; other shared living quarters.
rules.effective_date_note: The ordinance was adopted on a Tuesday in 2021 and took effect Nov. 19, 2021. The exact adoption date is not stated.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (eff. Nov. 19, 2021)
citation_aliases: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinances
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.review_note: The passages are city summaries and do not give the municipal code section number. The 3-month relocation figure is the city's description of the ordinance.
rules.source_notes: Official City of Santa Ana news release and web page, which are secondary summaries of the ordinance. The state just cause law (Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2) and the Los Angeles and San Diego provisions in the other passages are not Santa Ana law and are excluded.
